result:
A has implemented round 106: a held key now announces the same refusal only once. Separate presses still announce every time, and the held key still moves the clip, loop or marker on every repeat. One part of B's plan was wrong: a single clip at time 0 with Snap off never shows a refusal, before or after this change. So two of C's browser rows need the revised setup below.

**What changed** (end hashes in `a-round-106/end-hashes.txt`; state is now 6 M + 4 ??, the frozen list is 535/535 at start and end, HEAD is still `3b6178b`):
- **Code:** all six paths (P1–P6) use one option name, `keyRepeat`, across `ArrangementContext.tsx` (`65a81c6d`), `StudioWorkspace.tsx` (`ce70fcb5`), `ArrangementLoopBrace.tsx` (`c5e6af8b`), `ArrangementMarkerRow.tsx` (`58d9b313`) and `ArrangementDetailPanel.tsx` (`900350a5`). Every change is inside B's narrow ranges. The reducer and every other `setStatus` call are unchanged.
- **Tests:** SK1–SK12 are a pure addition to `status-announcement-ui.test.tsx` (`581db1e7`). Lines 1–391 are byte-identical to the snapshot. The added lines have no `as`, `@ts-` or `any`.
- **Doc 092** (`4e2ed121`) is updated as the task asked: status, Approach, Mermaid diagram, changed files, keyboard rule, the forbidden k8 fix and the rejected k9 rule, testing and TODO.

**Checks run:**
- `npm run typecheck`: exit 0.
- `npm run lint`: exit 0, with 0 diagnostics in the owned files. `npx biome check` on the 6 code and test files is clean.
- Targeted vitest: 69 files, 1138 tests, all pass. That is B's expected 1134 plus SK9–SK12; no extra files.
- **Fail-before** against the round-105 snapshots: SK1–SK12 fail, SU1–SU6 pass.
- **Mutations k1–k12:** each one fails the expected tests, and the unmutated control passes 18/18. A few fail more tests than B listed, for reasons given in the report: k1 also fails SK7, and k8 also fails SU5.
- **My own browser check** (not C acceptance), at 1280 and 1440: 31 in-page repeats added the refusal once, and one separate press added exactly one more. The clips did not move, and there were no errors, forbidden requests or Authorization headers.

**The time-0 premise:** the clip is clamped to time 0 with no change, so nothing is announced and no Undo entry is made. The single-clip refusal only fires when a neighbouring clip blocks the move. I left that behaviour alone because it is out of scope and recorded it for B as A-R106-TIME0-SILENT. SK1 and SK7 therefore use a clip with a left neighbour.

**For C — two revised rows** (full recipes in report §8):
- **KR-NUDGE-SNAPOFF:** press Enter twice on the Middle East row to make two back-to-back clips, then Fit. Select the second clip, hold ArrowLeft, then press once separately.
- **KR-NUDGE-MOVES:** same two clips. Open a 0.300 s gap with three ArrowRight presses, then hold ArrowLeft.
- Expect 1138 for T106-TARGETED.
- All other rows apply as written.

**Code-reviewer** (score 8/10, nothing blocking):
- **F1/F2 fixed:** I added SK9–SK12. They cover a refusal that first appears during the hold, the marker-conflict text, and Enter in the range input.
- **F3/F4 left as is:** the rare stale-status case is accepted, and `status` stays in the `stepMarker` deps as B asked.
- **Handed to B, outside my file ranges:**
  - F5: holding Enter on the ◀/▶ marker buttons or the Clip Gain reset button repeats the same text.
  - F6: Ctrl/Cmd+E, Ctrl+L, Ctrl+Shift+L and Ctrl/Cmd+C have no repeat guard. Held Ctrl+L also turns the loop on and off on every repeat.
- **Architecture note:** quoted verbatim in report §6 as a proposal for B/root; I did not refactor anything.

I'm not claiming any C acceptance row. I did not run the full suite, `npm run verify`, the build or the e2e smoke; those belong to the root gate. No commits or pushes.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-106.md`, with `a-round-106/a-round-106-summary.json` alongside.
